description: Search Myntra by keyword, browse categories or brands, or fetch listings, product URLs, and product IDs.

brands.description: One or more brands to browse (mode=browseByBrand), e.g. `nike`, `levis`, `tommy hilfiger`. Spaces and punctuation are normalized automatically.
brands.title: Brands

containsKeyword.description: Only products whose name contains this keyword (case-insensitive). Leave empty for all products.
containsKeyword.title: Keyword in product name

gender.description: Restrict listing results to one gender segment. Applied on Myntra's side.
gender.title: Gender

includeDetails.description: Open each product page to add sellers, addresses, per-size stock and measurements, specifications, rating breakdown, policies, videos, and tags. Slower but much richer. URL and product-ID modes always fetch details.
includeDetails.title: Fetch product details

includeReviews.description: Emit one row per written review with recordType `review`, in addition to product rows.
includeReviews.title: Include written reviews

maxItems.description: Total product rows to save across all queries, categories, brands, and URLs (1-10000). Review rows are additional.
maxItems.title: Max products

maxPrice.description: Only products whose selling price is at most this amount. 0 means no maximum.
maxPrice.title: Max price (INR)

maxReviewsPerProduct.description: Review rows to fetch for each product when written reviews are enabled (1-2000).
maxReviewsPerProduct.title: Max reviews per product

minDiscount.description: Only products discounted by at least this percentage. 0 means no minimum.
minDiscount.title: Min discount (%)

minPrice.description: Only products whose selling price is at least this amount. 0 means no minimum.
minPrice.title: Min price (INR)

minRating.description: Only products rated at least this value (0-5). Products without a rating are excluded when this is above 0.
minRating.title: Min rating

mode.description: What to fetch. Each mode has its own input list below.
mode.title: Mode

productIds.description: Numeric Myntra product IDs or product URLs (mode=byProductIds), e.g. `36674095`.
productIds.title: Product IDs

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional override. Leave untouched and the actor selects a working connection automatically.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

searchQueries.description: One or more keyword searches (mode=search), e.g. `tshirts`, `printed kurtas`, `nike running shoes`. Each query is fetched separately and duplicates are removed.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

splitLargeSearches.description: Go past the per-filter result cap by fetching gender, price-band, and sort slices, then removing duplicates. Recommended for deep exports.
splitLargeSearches.title: Split large searches

startUrls.description: Myntra listing, search, category, brand, or product URLs (mode=byUrl). Product URLs are fetched as products; everything else is fetched as a listing.
startUrls.title: Listing or product URLs

title: Myntra Scraper Input
